angularDiameterSource: No angular diameter is measured: this is the record's radius at the Gaia distance.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 source 6070080754075553792: parallax 9.3031 +/- 0.0346 mas (RUWE 1.08), inverted to 107.4912 pc with no zero-point correction.
radiusSource: Radius 1.77 +/- 0.05 solar radii, temperature 8840 +/- 200 K and mass 1.96 +/- 0.04 solar masses from Chauvin et al. (2017, A&A 605, L9; arXiv:1707.01413), Table 1: an isochrone radius and a temperature from the A2V spectral type (Pecaut calibration), not a measured disc. 1,231,389 km at 695,700 km per solar radius; GM from 1.96 solar masses, the stellar mass Blunt et al. (2023) adopt for the orbit placed here, times the JPL solar GM. presentationUp: the display axis (celestial north at the star) is up; no spin axis is measured on the sky.
effectiveTemperatureSource: 8840 +/- 200 K, Chauvin et al. (2017), A&A 605, L9, Table 1, https://arxiv.org/abs/1707.01413
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/hip-65426.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.234, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HIP 65426 (pscomppars): spectral type A2 V, from Chauvin et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...605L...9C/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HIP 65426 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 1.26895, from TICv8 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HIP 65426 (pscomppars): age 0.014 Gyr, from Chauvin et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...605L...9C/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HIP 65426 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 299 km/s, from Chauvin et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...605L...9C/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius. The star's disc is not resolved; its color is Gaia's spectrum of it.
